jobs.title: Founding Business Development Representative
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. We’re looking for a Founding Business Development Representative to build Loora’s outbound motion from the ground up. This is a high-impact opportunity to define our target market, identify and engage enterprise prospects, develop messaging and outbound playbooks, and create the pipeline that will fuel Loora’s next stage of B2B growth. You’ll work closely with the B2B sales and leadership team, with significant ownership over how we approach the market. This role is ideal for a true outbound hunter who enjoys opening doors, experimenting with messaging, and turning data and market feedback into a repeatable sales motion. What You’ll Do - Identify, research, and prioritize high-potential enterprise accounts across key markets and industries. - Build and maintain target account lists and map key decision-makers and stakeholders within each account. - Execute highly personalized, multi-channel outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, phone, and other channels. - Develop and continuously optimize messaging, sequences, and cadences based on results. - Engage prospects to uncover business needs, pain points, and potential use cases for Loora. - Qualify prospects based on ICP fit, business need, relevant stakeholders, and timing, and book qualified discovery meetings with the AE. - Maintain accurate CRM data and manage outbound workflows in HubSpot and other sales tools. - Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to share market insights and improve messaging and positioning. - Track activity, conversion, and pipeline metrics and use data to continuously improve performance. - Help build Loora’s outbound playbook, including ICP definition, messaging, qualification criteria, sequences, and best practices. What We're Looking For - 2–5 years of experience in SDR, BDR, Business Development, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in B2B SaaS. - Proven success generating qualified meetings and pipeline through outbound prospecting. - Native or near-native English proficiency. - Exceptional written and verbal communication is essential. - A true hunter mentality -persistent, curious, proactive, and motivated by opening new doors. - Strong ability to research accounts and personalize outreach based on business context. - Comfortable using data to prioritize accounts, test messaging, and improve conversion. - Experience with outbound and sales technology such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Lusha, or similar tools. - Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, personalization, and sales productivity. - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment with a high degree of ownership and ambiguity. - Genuine interest in AI, EdTech, and the future of workplace learning. - Additional languages such as Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, or Italian are a strong advantage. - Experience mentoring or leading BDRs is a plus.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. We are looking for a Backend Engineer to drive the architecture and development of our AI-powered language learning platform. In this role, you will design and implement backend systems that directly impact millions of learners worldwide. You will architect scalable services that power real-time AI conversations, ensuring low-latency performance and reliability while building the foundation for our next generation of language learning features. What You’ll Do - Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs (REST and gRPC) that power AI-driven conversational experiences. - Build and optimize asynchronous Python applications capable of handling real-time audio/text processing at scale. - Ensure seamless, low-latency integration between mobile and web clients and our AI backend platform. - Drive technical decisions on system architecture, focusing on low latency and fault-tolerance. - Collaborate with AI/ML, mobile, DevOps, and product teams to deliver end-to-end solutions that delight our users. - Work within CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth deployments and maintain high code quality standards. - Optimize system performance and resource utilization while maintaining reliability SLAs for our growing user base. What We're Looking For - Minimum of 7 years of experience designing and developing scalable, distributed backend systems in one or more modern programming languages (Python is a plus). - Deep expertise in Python concurrency and execution models (WSGI, ASGI, asyncio, multiprocessing, threading, GIL). - Proven track record building production-ready asynchronous Python applications serving high-volume traffic. - Strong experience with Pydantic and FastAPI in production environments. - Expertise in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and gRPC services with strong emphasis on versioning strategies and backward/forward compatibility. - Demonstrated ability to solve complex performance, scalability, and workload distribution challenges. - Proficiency with relational and non-relational database solutions (PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB, MongoDB), including query optimization and data modeling. - Experience with event-driven architectures and message queuing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS). - Hands-on experience with Docker, understanding of CI/CD pipelines and methodologies, and working in Kubernetes/AWS-based deployments. - Strong proficiency with AWS cloud services and cloud-native architectures. - Understanding of observability practices (distributed tracing, metrics, logging) and experience with monitoring tools. Even better if you have: - Proficiency in additional backend programming languages (Go, Rust, Java, Scala, Kotlin). - Experience with audio/video streaming protocols and real-time communication systems. - Experience with dataframe libraries (Pandas, Polars, Daft) for data processing and analytics. - Familiarity with LLM integration libraries (LiteLLM, LangChain, Guidance, Instructor) and AI model serving frameworks. - Background in building data-driven applications, pipelines, or ETL processes using frameworks like Apache Spark / Flink and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster. - Contributions to OSS projects on GitHub.

jobs.title: Backend & Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. We are looking for a Backend Engineer with deep data engineering expertise to build and evolve the systems that power Loora's product, analytics, experimentation, and AI development. You will work across production backend services and data infrastructure, taking technical ownership of the full data lifecycle - from event ingestion and real-time processing to orchestration, modeling, quality, and reliable data access. This role combines hands-on backend development with ownership of Loora's shared data platform, working closely with backend, frontend, AI, DevOps, analytics, and product teams. What you'll do: - Build and maintain production-grade Python and Java backend services, APIs, and reactive data-processing pipelines with clear interfaces, resilient failure handling, and comprehensive observability. - Own and evolve Loora's batch and streaming data pipelines supporting product analytics, learner insights, experimentation, and AI model training. - Design and maintain trusted data models, shared metrics, and semantic-layer business logic across the analytical data platform. - Define and enforce standards for data contracts, testing, lineage, freshness, and observability. - Develop reliable approaches to schema evolution, backfills, replay, workload distribution, and failure recovery. - Collaborate with DevOps, backend, frontend, AI, analytics, and product teams to deliver reusable data capabilities and maintain clear system boundaries. What we're looking for: - At least 6 years of production software engineering experience, primarily in backend systems, including meaningful ownership of data-intensive platforms or infrastructure. - Strong proficiency in Python, Java, and SQL, with experience in testing, typing, performance optimization, and production debugging. - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including service and API design, asynchronous and concurrent processing, failure handling, and operational reliability. - Experience with relational and non-relational databases such as PostgreSQL, Redis, or MongoDB. - Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and production observability. - Deep experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines and batch or streaming data systems. - Hands-on production experience with Apache Flink for distributed stream processing. - Hands-on production experience building reactive data-processing pipelines with RxJava/Project Reactor, including backpressure, scheduling, error handling, testing, and operational debugging. - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems such as Kafka or AWS SQS. - Strong understanding of data modeling, warehouse and lakehouse architecture, schema evolution, and data quality. - Hands-on experience with dbt for data modeling, testing, documentation, lineage, and semantic-layer development. - Hands-on experience with at least one analytical data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, ClickHouse, Athena, Trino, or Dremio. - Hands-on experience with at least one dataframe library: Pandas, Polars, or Daft. - Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster. - Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset, with a track record of leading cross-functional technical initiatives through to production. EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE - Experience with data integration and ingestion platforms such as Airbyte, Rivery, or AWS AppFlow. - Experience with conversational AI, speech/audio systems, or real-time communication. - Production experience with Go, Rust, Scala, or Kotlin. - Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects.

Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to build our Web products. The web is a first-class product surface for us, powering our core AI English learning product, Business dashboards, and user acquisition initiatives. You'll own features end-to-end, from Figma to shipped, performant UI, collaborating closely with design, product, and non-technical stakeholders. What you'll do: - Build and ship core product features across our core AI English tutor web experience alongside to acquisition funnels, dashboards, SEO and our company site - Turn Figma designs into clean, accurate, responsive UI - Extend and improve our internal component library - Partner directly with designers, PMs, and non-technical stakeholders to shape and refine features - Continuously improve web and mobile-web performance — load time, rendering, bundle size - Own test coverage for the features you build - Make technical tradeoffs independently and drive decisions in your area - Incorporate AI/agentic coding tools into your day-to-day workflow What we're looking for: - 5+ years of frontend experience, ideally on high-traffic consumer products - Proven experience with React, TypeScript, and Next.js https://nextjs.org/, you've shipped and maintained production apps at scale - Strong CSS Modules and modern CSS (Grid, animations, transitions, custom properties) - An eye for design and high-fidelity Figma-to-code execution - Experience building or maintaining an internal component library or design system ideally with Storybook - Solid understanding of web/mobile-web performance and the tradeoffs involved - Experience with testing, including e2e testing with Playwright - Strong communication skills, comfortable working directly with designers, PMs, and non-engineers, and giving/receiving feedback - Willingness to dip into backend/Python codebases when needed to unblock your own work - Hands-on experience using AI/agentic coding tools in real production workflows - Good product sense Even better if you have: - Experience with a headless CMS (Strapi or similar) - Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook, PostHog) - Familiarity with Analytics/tracking infrastructure (Mixpanel, attribution)

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager- B2B
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. As we scale Loora’s B2B business, we’re looking for a strategic and hands-on Senior Product Marketing Manager to define how Loora enters, positions, and grows in the B2B market. The Role You will own positioning, ICP, messaging, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, pricing; packaging insights, and GTM strategy. You’ll work closely with the B2B GM, Product, Sales and Marketing to turn customer insights into a clear market strategy and a repeatable commercial motion. This is a build-from-zero role: you’ll create the playbook rather than inherit one. What You’ll Own - Define Loora’s B2B positioning, messaging, category narrative, and differentiation. - Build and refine the ICP, target segments, personas, and use cases. - Conduct customer and market research and translate insights into GTM priorities. - Build the first sales enablement foundation - pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, discovery frameworks, case studies, and ROI messaging. - Lead competitive intelligence and pricing and packaging research. - Turn pilot and customer results into compelling proof points and commercial insights. - Lead GTM plans and launches for new B2B products and capabilities. - Build the processes and foundation for the Product Marketing function, eventually growing the team. What We׳re Looking For - 6–8 years in Product Marketing, GTM, or a related role, with strong B2B SaaS/ AI experience. - Proven experience in positioning, messaging, ICP, sales enablement, and GTM strategy. - Strong understanding of B2B and enterprise buying processes. - Experience launching products or entering new markets globally. - Excellent storytelling, writing, and communication skills. - Native-level English proficiency- exceptional spoken and written English is essential - Strong commercial mindset and ability to connect customer insights to business impact. - Strategic thinker who is also highly hands-on and comfortable building from scratch.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. As we scale Loora’s B2B business, we’re hiring an Account Executive to help build our sales engine from the ground up. The Role In this role you’ll own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and discovery through pilots, negotiation, and closing. You’ll work closely with the B2B GM, Product Marketing, Marketing, and Product teams to define and refine the sales process, refine the ICP and messaging, and turn early customer wins into a repeatable sales motion. This is not a role where you inherit a pipeline. You’ll help build it. What You’ll do: - Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to close. - Build and manage your own pipeline through outbound, inbound, referrals, and partnerships. - Identify and engage decision-makers across L&D, HR, Talent, and education. - Run discovery calls, product demos, pilots, negotiations, and closing. - Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and translate them into compelling business cases. - Work closely with Product Marketing to refine ICP, messaging, objections, and sales materials. - Build and document the sales playbook based on what works. - Provide continuous feedback on market trends, competitors, pricing, and customer needs. What we’re Looking For - 4–8 years of B2B SaaS/ AI sales experience, with a strong track record of closing new business. - Experience owning a full sales cycle, ideally selling to mid-market or enterprise customers. - Strong prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and closing skills. - Comfortable selling a new product and category without an established brand or playbook. - Strong commercial judgment and ability to navigate complex buying processes. - Excellent communication and presentation skills. - Highly entrepreneurial, hands-on, and comfortable building from zero. - Native-level English proficiency- exceptional spoken and written English is essential Even better if you have- - Experience selling AI, SaaS, EdTech, or corporate learning solutions. - Existing relationships with L&D, HR, Talent, or education buyers. - Experience as an early sales hire or Founding AE at a startup.

jobs.title: AI Researcher
jobs.description: Loora is on a mission to revolutionize education and break down language barriers with its cutting-edge AI, building the first-ever personal AI English tutor. Loora offers its users an AI tutor that is always available to talk about whatever they want, give immediate feedback on English skills, and guide them on their journey to fluency. We're looking for an AI Researcher to help design and enhance Loora’s core intelligence capabilities. You'll work at the frontier of large language models and conversational AI - run experiments, develop novel techniques, and transform research breakthroughs directly into product impact. This is a role for someone who wants to research real-world challenges and ship to production: you'll be pushing the state of the art in domains like conversational dynamics, speech understanding, and agentic question answering, while seeing your work reach millions of language learners. What You'll Do: - Drive original AI research across LLMs, dialogue systems, speech, and language understanding — from hypothesis through design and all the way to deployment - Design and run rigorous experiments; develop novel model architectures, fine-tuning strategies, and training methodologies - Own the full research lifecycle — ideation, experimentation, evaluation, and deployment into production - Apply and extend state-of-the-art techniques (RL, instruction tuning, RAG, agentic workflows, multimodal models) to real user-facing challenges - Collaborate with engineering and product to transform research findings into shipped features - Define research direction in your area and contribute to Loora's long-term AI roadmap What We're Looking For - MSc or PhD in Machine Learning, AI, NLP, or a related field - A track record of bringing academic research to industry applications - A strong publication record at top-tier venues — NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or NAACL - Proven experience researching and deploying production-grade ML or AI systems - Deep hands-on experience with PyTorch, Transformers, and modern LLM tooling - Solid understanding of LLM pretraining, fine-tuning, post-training and alignment techniques - Strong coding skills and comfort working across the research-to-production boundary
